raw_segments.text: Distimona. Do not doubt that. Before Amelia here I give thee Warren of thy place. Assure
thee if I do vow a friendship I'll perform it to the last article. My lord shall never
rest. I'll watch him tame and talk him out of patience. His bed shall seem a school,
his board a shrift. I'll intermingle everything he does with Cassio's suit. Therefore be
merry Cassio, for thy solicitor shall rather die than give thy cause away.
